fusions.name: Itching Bite
fusions.desc: A quick bite that deals 7 damage and makes the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds. It heals you for 25% of the damage dealt, and you move 20% faster for 2 seconds after using it. Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up.

fusions.name: Skitter Barrage
fusions.desc: Kicks up 3 flecks at once, spread apart, each dealing 3 damage. Each hit has a 25% chance to leave the target [Hindered], slowing its attacks, for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Table to Table
fusions.desc: Carries you 7 tiles forward in a single leap, and your movement speed rises 25% for 3 seconds afterward.

fusions.name: Next Host
fusions.desc: Each time you kill something, a flea springs to the nearest enemy within 7 tiles and bites it, dealing 6 damage. You have 5% more dodge chance. Once every 4 seconds.
